Gentle family dentistry in Port Ellery

Cleanings, fillings, crowns and same-day emergency visits for the whole family. We have cared for smiles on the harbor for over fifteen years, and we would love to meet you and your family at your next checkup.

New patients are always welcome. Call us or send a message and we will find a time that works for you.

Harborline Dental · 12 Example Quay, Port Ellery · Open Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm, and Saturday mornings by appointment.

Insurance accepted: most major dental plans. Financing available for larger treatments. Free parking behind the building.
